python.title: Python File Scanner
python.objective: Build a Python script that scans a directory and lists files larger than a specified size.
task: Ask the user for a directory path.
python.bonus: Export the results to a CSV file.

python.title: Python System Information Tool
python.objective: Create a command-line tool that displays useful system information.
python.bonus: Format the output as a clean system report.

python.title: Python Log Analyzer
python.objective: Create a script that analyzes a log file and counts different types of events.
python.bonus: Display the five most common error messages.

javascript.title: Remove Duplicate Values
javascript.objective: Create a JavaScript function that removes duplicate values from an array.
task: Create an array containing duplicate values.
Write a function that removes duplicates.
javascript.bonus: Create a version that works with an array of objects.

javascript.title: Async API Request
javascript.objective: Create a JavaScript program that retrieves data from a public API.
task: Send a request to a public API.

linux.title: Linux Disk Usage Monitor
linux.objective: Create a Bash script that reports filesystems using more than 80 percent disk space.
linux.bonus: Write the warning to a log file.

linux.title: Linux Process Investigation
linux.objective: Investigate running processes using standard Linux commands.
task: Find the processes consuming the most CPU.
Find the processes consuming the most memory.
Identify a specific process by name.
linux.bonus: Create a Bash script that generates a process report.

git.title: Feature Branch Workflow
git.objective: Practice a complete Git feature branch workflow.
git.bonus: Repeat the exercise using a pull request.

sql.title: SQL JOIN Practice
sql.objective: Practice retrieving related information from multiple database tables.
sql.bonus: Add a third table and perform a three-table JOIN.

networking.title: Linux Network Investigation
networking.objective: Use Linux networking tools to investigate the current network configuration.
task: Test connectivity to a remote host.
networking.bonus: Document the complete network path using traceroute.

react.title: React Component Practice
react.objective: Create a reusable React component that displays information about a developer.
task: Accept name and role as props.
react.bonus: Add a technology list to each developer card.

react.title: React State Counter
react.objective: Build an interactive counter using React state.
react.bonus: Add a reset button and prevent the counter from going below zero.

nodejs.title: Build a Basic Express Server
nodejs.objective: Create a simple Express server with basic HTTP routes.
task: Return JSON from the API route.
nodejs.bonus: Add a /api/health endpoint that returns the server status.

nodejs.title: Create a REST API
nodejs.objective: Build a small REST API for managing developer projects.
nodejs.bonus: Add PUT /projects/:id to update an existing project.

azure.title: Azure Resource Group Planning
azure.objective: Design a basic Azure environment using resource groups and common cloud resources.
task: Create a diagram of a simple Azure environment.
Choose where a virtual machine would be deployed.
Document why each resource is needed.
azure.bonus: Create the environment using Azure CLI commands.

azure.title: Azure CLI Resource Investigation
azure.objective: Use Azure CLI to investigate resources in an Azure environment.
task: List resources inside a resource group.
azure.bonus: Create a Bash script that generates an Azure resource report.

windows.title: Windows PowerShell System Report
windows.objective: Create a PowerShell script that generates a basic Windows system report.
windows.bonus: Export the report to a CSV file.

windows.title: Active Directory User Investigation
windows.objective: Practice investigating users and groups in an Active Directory environment.
task: Find members of a security group.
windows.bonus: Create a PowerShell report listing disabled accounts.

security.title: Linux File Permission Audit
security.objective: Investigate Linux file permissions and identify potentially risky configurations.
task: Identify which files are writable by everyone.
security.bonus: Write a Bash script that reports world-writable files.

security.title: Password Security Investigation
security.objective: Learn how password security is improved through strong authentication practices.
task: Explain why password reuse is dangerous.
Explain how MFA improves account security.
Design a basic password policy for a small company.
security.bonus: Create a security checklist for new employee accounts.

networking.title: Linux Network Investigation
networking.objective: Use Linux networking tools to investigate the current network configuration.
task: Test connectivity to a remote host.
networking.bonus: Document the complete network path using traceroute.

networking.title: DNS Troubleshooting Lab
networking.objective: Investigate and troubleshoot common DNS resolution problems.
task: Use dig to query a domain.
Identify the DNS server being used.
Compare results from two DNS servers.
networking.bonus: Document a troubleshooting procedure for a DNS server that is not responding.

git.title: Feature Branch Workflow
git.objective: Practice a complete Git feature branch workflow.
git.bonus: Repeat the exercise using a pull request.

git.title: Git Conflict Resolution
git.objective: Practice resolving a Git merge conflict safely.
task: Modify the same line in both branches.
git.bonus: Practice the same workflow using a GitHub pull request.
